AZR_Finfluencers.name: Finfluencers
AZR_Finfluencers.text: Public-facing stars and media staff: glamour, attention, sponsor value and popular appeal. Azure blue with hot-pink accents; camera-ready, privileged and branded. Valuable to Azure Reach, never disposable jokes.

AZR_Brine_Squad.name: Brine Squad
AZR_Brine_Squad.text: Operations and care reality: practical competence, animal calm, life-support awareness and invisible labor. Dark navy / black-blue with cyan technical accents. Functional and indispensable; do not turn them into a dry repair procedural.

AZR_Guest_Relations.name: Guest Relations
AZR_Guest_Relations.text: Public interface and emotional translation: guest control, hospitality and clarification under pressure. Lighter blue / teal, neat and approachable, socially agile and overextended.

AZR_Corporate.name: Corporate / Management
AZR_Corporate.text: Polished institutional authority: sponsors, growth, valuation, brand and controlled pressure. Pale blue / slate executive tones. Absurd and sponsor-conscious but not malicious.
